title: Mahilaon Ka Health Checkup — Umar Ke Hisaab Se, Deoria
description: 20, 30, 40 aur 50 ke baad mahilaon ke blood test — khoon ki kami, thyroid, sugar, Vitamin D aur menopause ki jaanch, Deoria me ghar par sample.
keywords: menopause ke baad kaun se test
mahilaon me khoon ki kami ki jaanch
women blood test at home Deoria
takeaways: Uttar Pradesh me lagbhag har doosri mahila me khoon ki kami milti hai. Thakan aur chakkar ko "ghar ka kaam" samajhne se pehle ek CBC kara lijiye.
Mahilaon me thyroid ki bimari purushon se kai guna zyada hai. 30 ke baad, ya periods, wazan aur thakan ki shikayat par TSH ek baar zaroor.
40 ke baad aur menopause ke aas-paas sugar, cholesterol aur Vitamin D badalte hain — saal ki jaanch me in teeno ko jodiye.
Periods ke dauraan blood test ho sakta hai, lekin urine test 2-3 din baad kijiye. Hormone test (LH, FSH) period ke khaas din par hote hain.

sections.heading: Mahilaon Ka Health Checkup Kyun Chhoot Jaata Hai — Aur Kyun Zaroori Hai
sections.lead: Ghar me sabki jaanch ki fikr karne wali mahila apni jaanch sabse aakhir me karati hai.
blocks: Deoria ke gharon me aam dekha jaata hai: bachchon ka bukhar, saas-sasur ki sugar, pati ka BP — sab ki report samay par, lekin maa ki apni thakan "kaam ki thakan" maan li jaati hai. Mahilaon ki kuch bimariyaan khaas taur par isi chup me badhti hain — khoon ki kami, thyroid, Vitamin D ki kami, aur 40 ke baad sugar tatha cholesterol.

Sarkaari sarvekshan (NFHS-5) ke hisaab se Uttar Pradesh me 15-49 saal ki lagbhag aadhi mahilaon me khoon ki kami (anaemia) hai. Iska matlab ye nahi ki har mahila bimaar hai — matlab ye hai ki ek saadi CBC yahan ki mahilaon ke liye sabse kaam ki jaanch hai, aur wo sasti bhi hai.

note.title: Is guide me kya nahi hai
note.text: Pap smear, mammography, ultrasound aur haddi ki jaanch (BMD) mahilaon ke checkup ka zaroori hissa hain, lekin ye khoon ki jaanch nahi hain aur hamari service nahi hain. Inke liye gynaecologist ya imaging centre jaana hoga. Ye guide sirf blood aur urine test ki hai.

sections.heading: Mahilaon Me Khoon Ki Kami Ki Jaanch — Haemoglobin, Ferritin Aur B12
sections.lead: Haemoglobin kam hai, ye pehla sawaal hai. Kyun kam hai, ye doosra — aur ilaaj usi par tikta hai.
blocks: Mahilaon me khoon ki kami ke aam kaaran hain periods me zyada khoon jaana, pregnancy aur doodh pilaana, khaane me iron kam hona, pet ke keede, aur shaakahaari khaane me B12 ki kami. Lakshan dheere aate hain: thakan, saans phoolna, chakkar, baal jhadna, naakhun kamzor, chehra peela, aur mitti ya chaawal khaane ka man (pica).

sections.heading: Thyroid Test For Women — Kab Aur Kyun
sections.lead: Mahilaon me thyroid ki bimari purushon se kai guna zyada aam hai.
blocks: Sust thyroid (hypothyroidism) mahilaon me wazan badhna, thakan, baal jhadna, periods zyada ya aniyamit, pregnancy na theharna aur udaasi deta hai — aur ye sab lakshan itne aam hain ki aksar kisi aur cheez ka maan liye jaate hain. TSH ek saada, bina fasting ka test hai.

list: 30 ke baad saal me ek baar, ya lakshan hon to kabhi bhi.
Pregnancy plan ho, ya pregnancy ki pehli jaanch ho.
Delivery ke 6 mahine ke andar thakan, udaasi ya dhadkan tez ho.
Ghar me maa ya behen ko thyroid ho.

sections.heading: Periods, PCOD Aur Pregnancy — Hormone Test Kab Aur Kaun Sa
sections.lead: Hormone test din dekh kar hote hain. Galat din ka sample galat kahani batata hai.
blocks: Periods aniyamit hon, chehre par baal ya muhaase badhein, wazan badhe ya pregnancy na theharne ki pareshani ho, to doctor aksar hormone test likhte hain — LH, FSH, prolactin, TSH, aur kabhi AMH ya testosterone. LH aur FSH aam taur par period ke doosre se paanchve din ke beech ka sample maangte hain, isliye booking periods ke hisaab se kijiye.
PCOD me kaun se test aur kis din, wo
me hai. Pregnancy ke har mahine ke blood test
me hain.

sections.heading: Menopause Ke Baad Kaun Se Test — Sugar, Cholesterol, Vitamin D Aur Haddiyan
sections.lead: Periods band hone ke baad sharir ki suraksha ki ek parat hat jaati hai.
blocks: Menopause (aam taur par 45 se 55 saal ke beech) ke baad estrogen hormone ghat jaata hai. Iska asar teen jagah dikhta hai: LDL cholesterol badhta hai aur dil ka jokhim purushon ke barabar aane lagta hai, pet ke aas-paas wazan aur sugar badhte hain, aur haddiyan tezi se kamzor hoti hain.

list: Periods ke dauraan blood test ho sakta hai. Lekin urine test periods khatam hone ke 2-3 din baad kijiye — khoon milne se report galat aati hai.
Iron ki goli chal rahi ho aur ferritin ya iron test ho, to goli sample ke baad lijiye.
Baal-naakhun ki biotin wali vitamin thyroid aur hormone test se 2-3 din pehle band kijiye.
Garbhnirodhak goli (OC pills) chal rahi ho to doctor ko bataiye — ye kuch hormone aur lipid ke number badalti hai.
Sugar aur lipid ho to 10-12 ghante fasting; baaki test par nahi.

faqs.question: Mahilaon ko kaun se blood test karane chahiye?
faqs.answer: Aam taur par CBC (khoon ki kami), TSH (thyroid), fasting sugar, urine routine; 30 ke baad lipid profile, Vitamin D aur B12; aur 40 ke baad HbA1c, LFT aur KFT bhi. Lakshan aur pariwaar ki bimari ke hisaab se doctor isme badlav karte hain.

faqs.question: 40 saal ke baad mahilaon ko kaun se test karane chahiye?
faqs.answer: CBC, fasting sugar aur HbA1c, lipid profile, TSH, Vitamin D, LFT, KFT aur urine routine — saal me ek baar. Iske alawa pap smear aur breast ki jaanch gynaecologist se, jo blood test nahi hain.

faqs.question: Menopause ke baad kaun se test zaroori hain?
faqs.answer: Lipid profile, fasting sugar aur HbA1c, Vitamin D, TSH aur CBC. Menopause ke baad cholesterol, sugar aur haddiyon ki kamzori ka jokhim badhta hai. Menopause ke baad yoni se khoon aaye to turant gynaecologist ko dikhaiye.

faqs.question: Mahilaon me haemoglobin kitna hona chahiye?
faqs.answer: Vayask mahilaon me aam taur par 12 g/dL ya usse zyada, aur pregnancy me 11 g/dL ya usse zyada. Apni report par chhapi range hi aakhri maaniye. Kam ho to ferritin aur B12 se kaaran dekha jaata hai.

faqs.question: Kya periods ke dauraan blood test kara sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan, zyadatar blood test periods me bhi ho sakte hain. Urine test periods khatam hone ke 2-3 din baad kijiye. Hormone test jaise LH aur FSH doctor period ke khaas din — aam taur par doosre se paanchve din — par karwate hain.

faqs.question: Deoria me mahilaon ka blood test ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Deoria Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Salempur, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni me sample ghar par liya jaata hai. Home collection ₹100, slot subah 6 baje se, aur report 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp aur email par PDF me.
